message: "a" depends on "app", the project that uses it: a package can't depend on what depends on it
Two packages are called "d": ../d2 (2.0.0, which "b" depends on) and ../d (1.0.0, which "app" depends on). A server runs one package of each namespace.
Packages depend on each other in a loop: "a" → "b" → "a"
"C:\packages\bad" isn't a folder relative to this project's, with / between its parts (like ../economy)
There's no project at ../nowhere (no netherforge.json there)
"minecraft" is reserved (for the game, the server or NetherForge), so no package has it
The project at ../other is "elsewhere", not "other": a dependency is named by the namespace of what it points at
There's no netherforge.lock pinning the packages this project depends on; the editor writes it, or run netherforge lock
